about: Stack budgets read by src/iot/tools/stack_budget.py (ESPR-4). A ratchet: each number is what the code used when it was set, lowered as the code shrinks and raised only in the commit that needs it, with the reason. `goal` is where the 2026-11-13 analysis says the bridge should be on its 4 KB cont stack (an interrupt adds >= 256 B at peak); the gate runs loop() on an 8 KB task stack. The path budget carries 48 B over the measured 3088 B for toolchain variance between hosts; frames carry none. The ESP32's GCC 8 cannot write a call graph, so the gate has no path budget.
